meas_data.label: N_photons_PMT
meas_data.title: Estimated Number of Emitted Photons per Pulse (PMT cross-cal)

comments: Estimated total number of emitted photons per pulse.
Method: PD picoamp signal ratio × angular-integration baseline.
Baseline derived from flange-calibration HDF5 data.
Air-to-ice correction applied via pre-measured sigmoid model.
Errors: systematic (distance, NIST resp., point-source approx.) and statistical (MC integration, signal noise, sim. mismatch).

support_files.comment: Raw HDF5 data. See POCAM documentation for details.
